findings.text: EPS $1.89 against $1.97 expected (-4.1%); revenue $201.94B against $202.22B expected (-0.1%). Results below estimates, reported 2026-10-29.
Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow turned to an outflow of $42.4 billion, driven by a $94.8 billion year-over-year increase in property and equipment purchases tied to AI investment.

The 10-Q says cash capital expenditures are expected to 'meaningfully increase in 2027,' and the company expects to undertake additional financing activities in 2026 after raising $135.8 billion of debt in the first nine months.

Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share; Amazon's 1.92 billion shares are reported as worth about $159 billion at that price, against an $18 billion investment. The stock is expected to start trading on 2026-11-19.

Q3 AWS net sales rose 39% to $46.0 billion and AWS operating income reached $17.8 billion. Management projects AWS revenue growth of over 40% in both 2027 and 2028, but gives no figure to compare against earlier guidance.

A news report says Amazon expects fourth-quarter operating income of $33.5 billion, against $25 billion a year earlier. No earlier guidance or consensus figure for that quarter is quoted, so this is context only.
Over the trailing 1, 3 and 12 months to 2026-11-18, AMZN moved +1.9%, +2.9% and +15.0%, against XLY (its Consumer Cyclical sector fund) at +3.2%, +2.2% and +4.2%.
VIX was 24.6 on 2026-11-18, against a one-year median of 17.2 and a one-year range of 13.5 to 31.0; the near-term level is above the three-month level (inverted term structure).
The next scheduled FOMC decision is 2026-12-09, 20 days from today; the following one is 2027-01-27.

Scheduled data releases are Gross Domestic Product and Personal Income and Outlays on 2026-11-25, Employment Situation on 2026-12-04, and Consumer Price Index on 2026-12-10; GDP and Personal Income and Outlays are next scheduled for 2026-12-23, and releases after that date are not yet scheduled.

definition.base_rate: share of past windows closing above their starting close; split-adjusted closes
definition.blend: own weight n/(n+k), n = years x 252 / trading days in the row; k = 900, 570, 380, 290 for 7, 14, 30, 60 days; 90 and 180 days use the pool average
definition.typical_move: 68th percentile of the absolute move over the horizon; not adjusted for volatility state
definition.volatility_state: 20-day realised volatility / its 252-day median; quiet < 0.8, active > 1.2
definition.trend: close against a simple moving average of 20, 50, 100, 200, 200, 200 days by row; description only
definition.uncertainty: one standard error of the own base rate, counting independent windows only
